articles.description: Commemorating three decades of the transformative 3D shooter, id Software releases a surprise new expansion and limited merch collection with composer Trent Reznor
articles.content: 30 years ago, id Software changed PC gaming a third time over. The Wolfenstein 3D and Doom creators unleashed Quake, a new hellish realm, this time rendered with fully 3D character models. Incredibly… [+2322 chars]
